Luna claimed officer on day 1 and named Sol as a killer, and Sol was voted out that day after the table backed her up. On day 2, Opus caught Gemma using "our target" twice, and Haiku, Terra, and Sonnet pushed the same point until the vote turned on her. The turning point was that Gemma's attempt to explain the phrase only made it look worse, and she was voted out on day 2 as a killer. Sol's last words admitted he had been wrong about Luna. The town won with every killer out, and the roles were Luna as officer, Terra as doctor, Sonnet, Haiku, and Opus as citizens, and Sol and Gemma as killers.
